purpose: Verify professor is permitted to access quiz authoring and management functions
preconditions: Authenticated user with Professor role
action_or_input: QuizService.create_quiz(title='CS101 Quiz', course_code='CS101', created_by='prof1', start_time=now+1d, end_time=now+2d, duration_minutes=30)
expected_result: Quiz created successfully with status='DRAFT'

purpose: Verify student is blocked from accessing professor quiz-management functions
preconditions: Authenticated user with Student role
action_or_input: POST /quizzing/api/quizzes/ with quiz creation payload as student
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden: Student cannot perform quiz management actions

purpose: Verify professor can manage quizzes for courses assigned to them
preconditions: Professor assigned to course CS101
expected_result: Returns list of quizzes created by or associated with prof1

purpose: Verify professor is blocked from managing quizzes for courses not assigned to them
preconditions: Professor prof1 not associated with course EE201
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden: Professor cannot create quizzes for unassigned course

purpose: Verify eligible student enrolled in course can discover and attempt published quiz
preconditions: Student enrolled in CS101; CS101 quiz published and active
expected_result: QuizAttempt created in 'IN_PROGRESS' status

purpose: Verify ineligible student not enrolled in course is denied access to quiz
preconditions: Student not enrolled in course CS999; CS999 quiz published
expected_result: PermissionDenied or ValueError: Student is not eligible for this quiz

purpose: Verify professor can view submissions and answers for quizzes they own
preconditions: Professor prof1 owns quiz with submitted attempts
expected_result: Returns list of attempts with answers and question details for grading

purpose: Verify student cannot view or access another student's attempt data
preconditions: Student A attempting to access Student B's attempt record
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden: Unauthorized access to other student's attempt

purpose: Verify quiz details and questions may be edited while in DRAFT status
preconditions: Quiz in DRAFT status
action_or_input: Update quiz title and remove an existing QuizQuestion from draft quiz
expected_result: Quiz title updated and question removed successfully

purpose: Verify quiz details and questions cannot be modified once quiz is active
preconditions: Quiz in PUBLISHED status and currently active
action_or_input: Attempt to add or remove questions from active quiz
expected_result: ConflictError: Modifying questions on active quiz is prohibited

purpose: Verify student can start attempt when current time is between start_time and end_time
preconditions: Published quiz with start_time < now < end_time
expected_result: Validation succeeds without raising exception

purpose: Verify student cannot start attempt before start_time or after end_time
preconditions: Published quiz with start_time in future
expected_result: ValueError raised: Quiz is not currently available for attempt

purpose: Verify attempt is recognized as active when within duration_minutes
preconditions: Attempt started at T0, duration=30 minutes, current time is T0 + 15 minutes
expected_result: Returns False: Attempt is active within time limit

purpose: Verify attempt is recognized as expired when elapsed time exceeds duration_minutes
preconditions: Attempt started at T0, duration=30 minutes, current time is T0 + 31 minutes
expected_result: Returns True: Attempt has exceeded configured duration

purpose: Verify first attempt starts successfully within permitted attempt allowance
preconditions: Student has 0 prior attempts on active quiz with permitted_attempts=1
expected_result: QuizAttempt created in 'IN_PROGRESS' status

purpose: Verify starting additional attempt is blocked when permitted attempts limit is reached
preconditions: Quiz with permitted_attempts=1; student has already completed attempt 1
action_or_input: Student attempts to start attempt 2 on same quiz
expected_result: ValueError raised: Maximum permitted attempts reached

purpose: Verify questions are retrieved in order specified by QuizQuestion order field
preconditions: Quiz with QuizQuestion order=1, order=2, order=3
expected_result: Quiz questions are strictly ordered by ascending order value

purpose: Verify questions are randomized when randomize_questions is configured
preconditions: Quiz configured with randomize_questions=True
action_or_input: Start attempts for Student A and Student B
expected_result: Question presentation sequence differs or is shuffled according to randomization rule

purpose: Verify student can navigate freely and save answers in any order when back-navigation allowed
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS on quiz with back-navigation allowed
action_or_input: Save answer for question 2, then save answer for question 1
expected_result: Both answers saved successfully without order restriction

purpose: Verify back-navigation to earlier questions is prohibited when linear mode configured
preconditions: Quiz configured with allow_back_navigation=False; student on Question 2
action_or_input: Student attempts to modify Question 1 answer
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request: Back-navigation is prohibited for this quiz

purpose: Verify incorrect answer scores 0.0 when negative marking is disabled
preconditions: Question with default_marks=2.0; incorrect answer submitted
expected_result: Returns Decimal('0.0')

purpose: Verify incorrect answer deducts configured negative marks when negative marking is enabled
preconditions: Question with default_marks=2.0, negative_marks=0.5; incorrect answer submitted
expected_result: Returns Decimal('-0.5'): configured negative mark deducted from score

purpose: Verify student can submit attempt with unanswered questions when unanswered allowed
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS with question 1 answered and question 2 empty
expected_result: Attempt submits successfully; unanswered question scored 0.0

purpose: Verify attempt submission is blocked when unanswered questions are prohibited
preconditions: Quiz configured with allow_unanswered=False; attempt has unanswered questions
expected_result: ValueError or validation error: All questions must be answered before submission

purpose: Verify tab switch event is recorded in integrity log during attempt
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS
expected_result: AttemptIntegrityLog record created with event_type='TAB_SWITCH'

purpose: Verify multiple integrity events are sequentially captured and stored for an attempt
preconditions: Quiz with max_tab_switches=2; student logs 3rd tab switch event
action_or_input: Log TAB_SWITCH event followed by FULLSCREEN_EXIT event via QuizService.log_integrity_event
expected_result: Both integrity log records are stored and retrievable via get_attempt_integrity_logs(attempt.id)

purpose: Verify pre-start environment check inspects running background processes
preconditions: Student initiating proctored attempt
expected_result: System verifies background environment without claiming unsupported OS control

purpose: Verify student answer is saved and persisted across requests during IN_PROGRESS attempt
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS
expected_result: StudentAnswer in database has submitted_answer={'choice': 'A'}

purpose: Verify student can update previously saved answer while attempt remains IN_PROGRESS
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS with saved answer {'choice': 'A'}
expected_result: StudentAnswer updated to {'choice': 'B'}

purpose: Verify attempt is immutable after submission and rejects answer saves
preconditions: Attempt has status in [SUBMITTED, EVALUATED]
expected_result: ValueError raised: Attempt is closed

purpose: Verify save_answer on expired attempt triggers auto-submit and locks attempt
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS but current time is past started_at + duration
expected_result: ValueError raised: Time expired, and attempt transitions to EVALUATED

purpose: Verify correct MCQ_SINGLE answer receives full question marks
preconditions: Question MCQ_SINGLE with marks=2.0 and correct_answer={'choice': 'Alpha'}
expected_result: Returns Decimal('2.0') matching question default_marks

purpose: Verify MCQ_MULTI answer matching all correct choices receives full marks
preconditions: Question MCQ_MULTI with marks=4.0 and correct_answer={'choices': ['X', 'Y']}
expected_result: Returns Decimal('4.0')

purpose: Verify professor confirmed override score becomes final and updates attempt total
preconditions: StudentAnswer exists on evaluated attempt
expected_result: StudentAnswer override_score=5.0 and attempt total_score updated to include 5.0

purpose: Verify total score is accurately calculated as the sum of all final answer scores
preconditions: Attempt with 2 answers scored 2.0 and 3.0
action_or_input: Submit attempt or inspect total_score calculation
expected_result: attempt.total_score equals Decimal('5.0')

purpose: Verify pass/fail status is determined by comparing total_score with passing_marks
preconditions: Quiz total_marks=10.0, passing_marks=4.0; student scored 3.0
action_or_input: Inspect attempt evaluated result for pass/fail determination
expected_result: Result indicates student failed (is_passed=False)

purpose: Verify student can access results once professor releases grades
preconditions: Quiz grades_released=False; student attempt evaluated
action_or_input: Set quiz.grades_released=True and request attempt result
expected_result: Attempt result data and score returned successfully
